lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits and pectoral fin, organized into five primary horizontal rows and approximately twelve vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, most clearly defined in the mid-flank region where they form stable grid-like nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin displays a distribution of approximately ten high-luminance blobs scattered across its lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white mark of high pixel intensity is visible at the distal tip of the right pectoral fin, indicating potential trauma or localized depigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of at least five remoras (Echeneidae) is visible in the water column directly ventral to the pectoral fin and lower flank.
